title: Session fixation mitigation via session.clear() on login
description: The login flow calls session.clear() before setting session['user_id'], preventing session fixation attacks where an attacker pre-sets a session ID. This is a verified security control (assertions.md §3) that must not regress.
spec:
1. Verify flaskr/auth.py login() calls session.clear() before setting session['user_id'] = user['id'] (currently at line 103).
2. Verify flaskr/auth.py logout() calls session.clear() to destroy the session.
3. Verify tests/test_auth.py confirms 'user_id' is not in session after logout.
